name: 29th Pacific Conference of the RSAI (PRSCO 2026): Prosperous Futures? Contested Knowledge for Sustainable Regions
edition: 29th Pacific Conference (hosted by ANZRSAI; also its 2026 annual conference)
organizer: Pacific Regional Science Conference Organization (PRSCO) with the Australia and New Zealand Regional Science Association International (ANZRSAI)
deadline_note: Abstract deadline originally 30 April 2026, extended to 14 May 2026; submission later reopened until 11 September 2026 (now passed).
submission_requirements: Proposals for contributed papers, themed panels or special sessions on any regional topic; abstracts via the ANZRSAI abstract upload form
registration_fee: Early bird (before 30 Sept): AUD 400 ANZ / AUD 390 RSAI non-ANZ / AUD 450 non-RSAI; standard AUD 450 / 440 / 500; student or emeritus AUD 200; one-day AUD 290-350; fees include ANZRSAI and PRSCO membership; 25% discount for participants from countries with GDP per capita of USD 20,000 or less
